texts.text:
ORDINANCE



        BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the M1-1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District, POS-1 Parks and Open
Space District, RS-2 and RS-3 Single Unit (Detached House) Districts and RT-4 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District symbols and identification as shown on Map No. 26-F in the area
bounded by:

        West 99th Street; west right-of-way line of Union Pacific Railroad; West 104th Street; a line 223.15
        feet starting from a point 31 feet west of the west right-of-way line of Union Pacific Railroad to a
        point 52.98 feet west of the west right-of-way line of Union Pacific Railroad; a line 52.98 feet west
        of and parallel to the west right-of-way line of Union Pacific Railroad; a line 298.59 feet south of
        and parallel to West 104th Street; west right-of-way line of Union Pacific Railroad; a line 299.00
        feet south of and parallel to West 107th Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Eggleston
        Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 107th Street; a line 110.00 feet east of and
        parallel to South Eggleston Avenue; West 107th Street; a line 35.00 feet east of and parallel to the
        alley next east of and parallel to South Eggleston Avenue and extended where no street exists; a
        line 216.00 feet north of and parallel to West 107th Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South
        Eggleston Avenue; a line 298.61 feet south of and parallel to West 104 th Street; a line 298.61 feet
        starting at a point 61.55 feet east of the alley next east of and parallel to South Eggleston Avenue
        to a point 188.12 feet east of South Eggleston Avenue; West 104th Street; the alley next east of and
        parallel to South Normal Avenue; West 103rd Place; a line 375.00 feet east of and parallel to South
        Normal Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to West 103 rd Place; a line 462.00 feet east of
        and parallel to South Normal Avenue; West 103rd Street; South Eggleston Avenue. (RLE Rezoning
        Section 2)

to those of a T, Transportation District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Addresses of Property: 400, 412, 414, and 418 W. 103rd Pl; 403, 405, and 409 W. 103rd St;
401 (partial), 405 (partial), 407 (partial), 408, and 414 W. 104th St; 400, 411, and 416 W. 105th St; 400,
405, 410, and 413 W. 107th St; 9901, 10411 (partial), 10413 (partial), and 10416 (partial) S. Eggleston
Ave; 10514, 10520, 10528, 10530, 10552, 10558, 10632, and 10638 S. Stewart Ave.
